intro_text: Welcome to the GeoLink Pro support page. Find answers to common questions and get help with the app.
faq_get_started_q: How do I get started with GeoLink Pro?
faq_get_started_intro: Getting started with GeoLink Pro is simple:
faq_get_started_step1: Open the GeoLink Pro app on your iPhone
faq_get_started_step2: Prepare your camera by enabling Bluetooth pairing mode
faq_get_started_step3: Pair your camera with the app through the Bluetooth connection
faq_get_started_step4: Once paired, your camera will automatically connect and start geotagging your photos
faq_enable_location_q: How do I enable location services?
faq_enable_location_a: Go to Settings > Privacy & Security > Location Services and ensure Location Services is enabled. Then grant GeoLink Pro permission to access your location.
faq_enable_background_q: How do I enable background geotagging?
faq_enable_background_intro: To enable background geotagging, make sure the following permissions and settings are configured:
faq_enable_background_step1: Set location permission to "Always" in Settings > Privacy & Security > Location Services > GeoLink Pro
faq_enable_background_step2: Grant Bluetooth permission when prompted by the app
faq_enable_background_step3: Keep Bluetooth enabled on your iPhone
faq_pair_camera_q: Do I need to pair my camera again if it's already paired with iOS?
faq_pair_camera_a: Yes, you need to pair your camera within the GeoLink Pro app even if it's already paired with iOS. iOS apps don't have access to system Bluetooth pairing information, so each app needs to establish its own connection with your camera.
faq_camera_wont_connect_q: My camera won't connect. What should I do?
faq_camera_wont_connect_intro: If your camera isn't connecting, try unpairing and pairing again:
faq_camera_wont_connect_step1: Unpair the camera from both the GeoLink Pro app and iOS system settings
faq_camera_wont_connect_step2: Pair the camera again through the app
faq_camera_wont_connect_followup: This often resolves connection issues by establishing a fresh Bluetooth connection.
faq_not_recording_q: The app isn't recording my location. What should I do?
faq_not_recording_intro: If the app isn't recording your location, try these troubleshooting steps:
faq_not_recording_step1: Make sure at least one camera is paired and powered on
faq_not_recording_step2: Verify that location services are enabled and GeoLink Pro has permission to access your location
faq_not_recording_step3: Ensure Bluetooth permission is granted and Bluetooth is enabled on your iPhone
faq_not_recording_step4: Check that the distance filter in app settings is set to a reasonable value (the default is None)
faq_not_recording_step5: Confirm you're in an area with good GPS signal
faq_not_recording_step6: Check that your device isn't in low power mode
faq_fujifilm_sync_q: My FUJIFILM camera isn't showing the location info synced icon or writing location data to photos. Why?
faq_fujifilm_sync_intro: If your FUJIFILM camera isn't displaying the location sync icon or embedding location data in your photos, check the following camera settings:
faq_fujifilm_sync_camera_step1: Go to NETWORK/USB SETTING > Bluetooth/SMARTPHONE SETTING > SMARTPHONE LOCATION SYNC. and ensure it's set to ON
faq_fujifilm_sync_camera_step2: Go to SET UP > SAVE DATA SETTING > GEOTAGGING and ensure it's set to ON
faq_fujifilm_sync_camera_step3: Go to SET UP > SCREEN SET-UP > LOCATION INFO and ensure it's set to ON
faq_fujifilm_sync_camera_step4: Go to SET UP > SCREEN SET-UP > DISP. CUSTOM SETTING > COMMUNICATION STATUS and ensure it's set to ON
faq_fujifilm_sync_app_step1: Go to the camera detail view in the app
faq_fujifilm_sync_app_step2: Disable the camera connection, then re-enable it to reconnect and refresh the Bluetooth connection
faq_fujifilm_sync_app_step3: Verify that the camera shows as connected in the app and that location services are active
faq_fujifilm_sync_app_step4: If the issue persists, try unpairing the camera from the app and pairing it again
faq_fujifilm_sync_footer: For detailed instructions specific to your camera model, please refer to your camera's manual. For X-T5 users, see the X-T5 Owner's Manual.
faq_sony_sync_q: My Sony camera isn't showing the location indicator or writing location data to photos. Why?
faq_sony_sync_intro: If your Sony camera isn't displaying the location indicator or embedding location data in your photos, check the following camera settings:
faq_sony_sync_camera_step1: Go to MENU > Network > Bluetooth and ensure it's set to ON, and that the camera is paired with the app
faq_sony_sync_camera_step2: Go to MENU > Network > Loc. Info. Link Set. > Location Info. Link and ensure it's set to ON
faq_sony_sync_app_step1: Go to the camera detail view in the app
faq_sony_sync_app_step2: Disable the camera connection, then re-enable it to reconnect and refresh the Bluetooth connection
faq_sony_sync_app_step3: Verify that the camera shows as connected in the app and that location services are active
faq_sony_sync_app_step4: If the issue persists, try unpairing the camera from the app and pairing it again
faq_sony_sync_footer: For detailed instructions specific to your camera model, please refer to your camera's manual or Sony's support documentation.
faq_fujifilm_outdated_q: My FUJIFILM camera is writing outdated location information to my photos. Why?
faq_fujifilm_outdated_p1: FUJIFILM cameras cache location data and will continue using the last received location information for up to 3 hours. After this period, the location data expires and the camera stops writing location information to new photos.
faq_fujifilm_outdated_p2: Additionally, when you first turn on your camera, GeoLink Pro needs approximately 10 seconds to establish the Bluetooth connection and start sending location updates. During this initial connection period, your camera may use outdated or no location data.
faq_fujifilm_outdated_step1: Wait until the app connects to the camera after it's powered on before taking photos
faq_fujifilm_outdated_step2: Check that both the communication (Bluetooth) status icon and the location status icon are displayed on your camera's screen, indicating an active connection and location sync. You can also verify the connection status in the GeoLink Pro app
faq_compatible_q: Which cameras are compatible with GeoLink Pro?
faq_compatible_intro: GeoLink Pro works with cameras that support Bluetooth connectivity for geotagging. Below is a list of compatible camera models:
faq_compatible_sony_creators: Any Sony camera that works with the Creators' app
faq_compatible_sony_imaging: Any Sony camera that works with Imaging Edge Mobile
faq_compatible_fujifilm_xapp: Any FUJIFILM camera that works with XApp
faq_compatible_footer: If your camera supports Bluetooth connectivity but isn't listed above, it may still be compatible with GeoLink Pro.
faq_free_vs_pro_q: What's the difference between Free and Pro mode?
faq_free_vs_pro_intro: GeoLink Pro offers a free mode for basic use and a subscription-based Pro mode for unlocking the full experience:
faq_free_vs_pro_free_step2: Location accuracy is restricted to "Reduced" mode
faq_free_vs_pro_free_step3: Limited to pairing with one camera at a time
faq_free_vs_pro_pro_step1: Removes the location accuracy restriction for full precision geotagging
faq_free_vs_pro_pro_step2: Allows unlimited cameras to be paired simultaneously
faq_free_vs_pro_pro_step3: Provides access to more advanced controls and customization options
faq_free_vs_pro_pro_step4: Unlocks all future GeoLink Pro features as they are released
